meta.name: All's Fair
meta.description: A team of female divorce attorneys leave a male-dominated firm to open their own powerhouse practice. Fierce, brilliant, and emotionally complicated, they navigate high-stakes breakups, scandalous secrets, and shifting allegiances—both in the courtroom and within their own ranks. In a world where money talks and love is a battleground, these women don't just play the game—they change it.

videos.title: Pilot
videos.overview: The firm's tenth anniversary brings two high-profile cases. Allura's personal life takes a dramatic turn.

videos.title: When We Were Young
videos.overview: A legendary lawyer comes out of retirement. Liberty weighs a pivotal decision.

videos.title: I Want Revenge
videos.overview: At work, a toxic marriage leaves lasting scars. After hours, Allura tends to her own.

videos.title: Everybody Dance Now
videos.overview: Emerald embraces her independence, until an unexpected turn forces the team to unite in pursuit of justice.

videos.title: Divorce Is Like a Death
videos.overview: The firm takes on their toughest, and most personal mediation yet.

videos.title: Letting Go
videos.overview: Dina struggles to say goodbye. Carr and Liberty's feud spills beyond the office.

videos.title: Oh, Jesus!
videos.overview: The firm considers a new addition. Carr takes a partner of her own.

videos.title: Interior Law Offices
videos.overview: Carr makes a to-do list. Liberty discovers marriage can be messier than divorce.

videos.title: The Scorpio Ball
videos.overview: Allura's extravagant Scorpio Ball promises a night of glamour, but an uninvited enemy threatens to bring out everyone's stingers. Meanwhile, a high-stakes divorce case puts Emerald and Liberty to the test.

videos.title: Going Down
videos.overview: A trip to scatter Dina's husband's ashes takes a harrowing turn when the women encounter trouble at 30,000 feet. Meanwhile, Allura's new bodyguard proves to be more than just a pretty face.

videos.title: Thanksgiving (1)
videos.overview: A Thanksgiving divorce dispute forces the ladies to trade their holiday plans for a feast at the firm. But as old wounds reopen and new secrets nearly spill, the holiday comes to a violent halt.

videos.title: Thanksgiving (2)
videos.overview: As the women grapple with the aftermath of the Thanksgiving from Hell, a shocking secret threatens to change everything.

videos.title: Liberty Unleashed
videos.overview: Liberty's newfound confidence sends shockwaves through the firm. Meanwhile, the ladies discover that hiring an HR director may have been their biggest mistake yet.

videos.title: Queens
videos.overview: Overwhelmed by her bosses, newly hired HR director, Reese begins to see the women of Grant, Ronson & Greene as a real drag.

videos.title: Frenemies
videos.overview: As tensions reach a breaking point, a controversial hiring decision threatens to tear the firm apart. Meanwhile, Dina gets a second chance, and an unlikely suitor catches Emerald's eye.
